item.title: Entanglement scaling in a two-dimensional Fermi gas & its tensor-network representation
item.description: arXiv:2410.01234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We compute the second Renyi entropy of a two-dimensional Fermi gas using a tensor-network ansatz, and show that the area law holds up to a logarithmic correction.
item.dc:creator: Ana Author, Bo Author, Cy Author, Di Author

item.title: Quantum Monte Carlo study of a frustrated spin ladder
item.description: arXiv:2410.05678v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We map out the phase diagram of a frustrated two-leg spin ladder with sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo and identify a dimerized phase.
item.dc:creator: Eve Author
